content: {"question":"For a US-based employee, when does their benefits coverage end and does the standard offboarding memo apply to them?","answer":"Their benefits coverage ends at the end of the month in which they leave, and the standard offboarding memo does apply to them because it is written for US-based employees.","evidence_a":"In the US, medical, dental, and vision coverage will end of the month during which you leave, all other benefits end on your last day.","evidence_b":"As written, it is applicable to US-based employees only."}
